name: adversarial-review
description: Cross-model consultation and adversarial review, driven by a peer agent CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Get advice or review from the other agent CLI
interface.longDescription: Cross-model consultation, plan review, and code review. The peer is always the agent CLI that is not running the skill: Claude Code uses Codex, and Codex uses Claude Code, so advice and critique come from a different model.
defaultPrompt: Ask the other model for an independent opinion on this decision.
Review this plan adversarially before I build it.
Run an adversarial code review on my uncommitted changes.
